purpose: Review official Prayagraj/Jhusi cadastral-service discovery and bounded anonymous API behavior.
assessment: The official Prayagraj district Hindi service links to UP Bhulekh, and the current Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha JavaScript/configuration was followed to public hierarchy and plot routes. Jhusi Kohna was identified in the official revenue hierarchy. Safe plot metadata worked anonymously for three bounded plot-number lookups; full polygon retrieval was held because the geometry endpoint required an Authorization header. No polygon is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Prayagraj district service page and official UP BhuNaksha/Bhulekh services. This is evidence of revenue/cadastral service custody only, not ownership, title, or citywide parcel availability.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Prayagraj district service and UP BhuNaksha; bounded Jhusi Kohna village test.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Hierarchy and safe plot metadata only; no anonymous full parcel polygon.

attempts: Fetched the official BhuNaksha viewer and inspected current JavaScript/configuration; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS exception used.
Queried the official hierarchy; Prayagraj district=175, Phulpur tehsil=00889, Jhusi Kohna village=161736.
Queried the map extent route for 17500889161736; upstream createGisCode dependency returned 403 through a 500 response, so no CRS/extent was retained.
Queried getPlotAtXY with the exact WUP point [25.4250788331479,81.9580751860907] in latitude/longitude order; response was {} for the bounded village context and was not interpreted as absence.
Queried plot numbers 1, 2, and 10; responses contained safe native ids, kide values, and projected bounding boxes, but no full geometry.
Queried the current plot geometry route with the safe id from plot 1; endpoint returned HTTP 401 Missing or invalid Authorization header. No token was sought or used.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Tested only against the bounded Jhusi Kohna village context; empty response is not evidence of citywide absence.

uncertainty: The current public geometry route may require a viewer session or authorization bootstrap.
The tested revenue village is not proven to contain the urban WUP point.
Citywide and countrywide parcel coverage remain unknown.
